红色真实分支内部斜直线缝、胃壁接口处纹理硬切。
纵向红管与蓝管有矩形材质接边；导管口边仍需高清薄唇。
蓝肾门切边尖楔和台阶，邻近红粉交接细线。
蓝肾门穿出边阶梯凹口，前景背景衔接较模糊。

左蓝支真实汇合斜直线缝，上方红短片贴纸感。

rootCause: 4x pigment-derived foreground steps can span2.4logicalpixels at0.15. Upsampling the quantized contour cannot recover smooth shape.
GPT region materials currently replace internal RGB only; complete outside banks and some junctions are still independently sampled strips.
strategy: Generate local high-resolution visible foreground lip alpha/material plus complete same-system node bank+floor material; fixed sourceBox and crop ports, never a new whole-body background.

Define one explicit high-resolution edge from the accepted visible lip, use the same edge/alpha for foreground raster, blood clipping and unit display; do not threshold generated colors into new topology.
Replace the entire same-system shared-node union including outside bank once. Different-system projected crossings remain independent planes.
Blend ports longitudinally over1.5-2existing tube widths using a common source-space UV phase and one outer bank; no transverse crop seam or internal wall across a true node.
Record contain contentBox, fixed ports, raw SHA and accepted patch mask. Native0.15 + unit movement must be read before claiming acceptance.
acceptance: No floating shard/capsule or cream wedge hole; mouth attaches to visible foreground lip.
True named-node merger has no transverse interior outline; unrelated projected crossing never becomes junction.
Blood does not enter actual food/air/urine cavity.
202samples/widths and organ silhouettes unchanged; display intervals may only change to match the accepted local lip.
Numerical coverage and visual smoothness remain separate results.

sequence: Confirm these two coupled scopes together; nine local crops cannot solve shared whole-body ribbon appearance alone.
Generate and inspect3 whole-pipe GPT source types, retaining raw sources and crop metadata.
Map main trunks first then branches; replace actual-node complete wall+floor while leaving projected cross-system crossings separate.
Generate/register9 local high-resolution foreground lips and complete joints where needed; same edge/alpha drives raster/clipping/display depth.
Inspect native0.15 on both ordinary long segments and every local patch, plus actual1x unit movement; record any remaining defect before visual acceptance.
acceptance: Continuous left/right walls and quiet flat lumen read as one organic vessel along straight/curved ordinary segments.
Main trunk→branch true junction is open and contains no transverse internal bank or stamp seam.
Independent system crossings preserve a readable over/under relation and do not become false junctions.
Every hidden mouth is attached to its actual foreground lip, with no isolated shard, wedge hole, capsule or stair-step crop.
No blood floor enters actual food/air/urine cavities; display units hide at the same accepted lip.
Whole202 numerical coverage and route stability are checked separately from native visual acceptance.

scopeSummary: PROPOSAL_ONLY: shared complete pipe material for all202 routes plus the9 fixed local high-resolution lips/joints; no generation or frozen asset/code edits.
